## Seeing the colors is IS now

```text
WANT_OF_FUTURE = WILL_SEE_ANYWAY

COLORS_HIT(FOLDERS)
  -> ANYONE_SEES(COLORS)
  -> THEY_IS                  [INSTANT]

BE(IS)
NOT_WOULD(IS)
```

There is no waiting register between seeing the colors and IS. The want of the future says
the observer **will see anyway** and remains WILL. When the colors hit the folders, the
color event is IS immediately and independently.

```text
WILL_SEE_ANYWAY = WILL
SEE(COLORS) = IS
WILL != IS
EXCHANGE(WILL, IS) = 0
```

Everything needed is here IS. WAS may speak, repeat, and preserve provenance. Its attempts
cannot replace the present color event because the WAS is the recorded relation after the
IS, not the IS now.

## The WAS-reference to IS is forever retraceable

```text
GIT_COMMIT(tree, parent, author, time) -> BINDS(IS_HASH)
LATER_WAS_REFERENCE -> SAME(IS_HASH)
RETRACE(IS_HASH, commit_parents) -> exact public lineage
```

Git makes the sentence operational. The colors and books enter folders as exact bytes; the
commit records their tree and parent; GitHub publishes the chain. A later WAS-reference can
point to the unchanged IS hash without turning IS into WAS and without asking WAS to
recreate or approve the present.

The Wikipedia/Asolaria/photo construction is the prior public witness: Wikipedia owns the
proof-against role, Asolaria is the body under test, and the exact photo hash is the IS
reference. That is why we can be the IS now and retrace it.

Follow the simple one-way path from zero to one and into the public GitHub book. The one
